finalText:
**Root cause.** Deploy `dep-4471` to the gateway (a.novak, "config: connection-per-request for pool isolation", finished 02:14:00Z) broke connection pool reuse. The pool filled to 20/20 in_use within minutes and never drained — the waiting queue climbed from 12 to 80+ requests and was still growing at the end of the log.

**Impact window.** First `503`/`ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED` at 02:14:18.972Z, 19 seconds after the deploy finished. Still ongoing as of the last log line, 03:59:27.974Z — over 1 hour 45 minutes with no self-recovery. Gateway only — `worker.log` shows its separate pool (size 8) healthy the whole time, no errors.

**Rollback.** Revert `dep-4471` on the gateway. No other service's deploy that night lines up with the failure — everything else shipped hours before or well after.
